title: Casey's progress — Week of August 17
audience: Casey's engineering manager and cross-functional partners
purpose: Explain verified movement, active attention, and the next decision for the week.

sections.title: Orientation
sections.summary: A measured reconciliation improvement landed while enterprise rollout remained ready behind one review dependency.

sections.title: Movement
sections.summary: Checkpoint batching improved the recorded replay, and rollout planning moved to three support-sized cohorts.

sections.title: Attention
sections.summary: Security review is the active rollout dependency, and the first cohort needs a manager decision.

sections.title: Forward view
sections.summary: The next validation step is to test alert thresholds against replay spikes before paging is enabled.

components.heading: This week
components.body: Reconciliation pipeline performance improved with corroborated evidence. Enterprise rollout is implementation-ready and awaiting one review before launch.

components.heading: Reconciliation pipeline
components.body: Checkpoint batching reduced the recorded 50,000-record replay from 18 minutes to 6 minutes after the pull request merged with passing checks.

components.heading: Enterprise rollout
components.body: The rollout will use three cohorts rather than one broad launch so each group stays within the response capacity of one on-call pair.

components.heading: Operating lesson
components.body: Replay-safe staging mode keeps duplicate callbacks from invalidating load-test comparisons.

components.heading: Active dependency
components.body: The enterprise pilot cannot start until security completes the data-retention review. Implementation is ready.

components.heading: Decision needed
items: Choose the first cohort by Friday, August 28, so enablement can send the onboarding schedule.

components.heading: Next-period priority
items: Validate alert thresholds against replay spikes before enabling paging.

claims.statement: Checkpoint batching reduced the recorded 50,000-record replay from 18 minutes to 6 minutes.

claims.statement: The enterprise pilot is waiting on completion of the data-retention review.
claims.implication: Implementation is ready, but the first cohort cannot start until security completes the review.

claims.statement: The manager needs to choose the first cohort by Friday, August 28.
claims.implication: A Friday decision lets enablement send the onboarding schedule.

claims.statement: Next period, validate alert thresholds against replay spikes before enabling paging.
claims.implication: Threshold validation keeps synthetic replay behavior from creating noisy operational alerts.

claims.statement: Staging load tests use replay-safe mode so duplicate callbacks do not invalidate comparisons.
